findings.why: the run must hold targetFps; the 5th percentile is 55
findings.what: fps 5 percentile 55 is below targetFps 60 (2 samples)

findings.why: The low-HP warning is a failure cue; if it can't be read, the player has no warning before the fall.
findings.what: The red `체력이 위험해요!` text under the player is drawn beneath the fire aura ring, gems and enemies, and cannot be read.

findings.why: the screen is dark and enemies are low contrast against the field
findings.what: none (stood still) → At 0:05 there were 1 kill, 8 or more enemies on screen and an XP gem at the left

findings.why: the player and enemies are low-contrast on the dark ground and are hard to tell apart at a glance
findings.what: key_down D, step 200 x10 → at 0:02 the field is very dark; the player is a small figure at the screen center with a small red bar. Enemies come in at the corners and edges. The `WASD` hint was not visible in this capture

findings.why: the damage numbers are small and low contrast against the dark field
findings.what: wait → at 0:11 kills 6, gold 2, XP bar about 50%; blue gems on the ground and damage numbers (`12`) float up

findings.why: no weapon choice at that level-up
findings.what: key P → At 0:11 (Lv 2) the level-up popup was open, so `P` did nothing and the run stayed held. The cards offered were `질풍 장화`, `바람의 깃털`, `분노의 불씨`, all passives, with no weapon card

findings.why: the first choice offers no new way to attack, so the choice feels like numbers only
findings.what: none → all three level-up cards at Lv 2 were new passives (바람의 깃털, 거인의 심장, 분노의 불씨); no weapon card was offered

findings.why: the first pick has no weapon choice, so a pick has less weight
findings.what: step → The first level-up popup opened at 0:04 (Lv 2, 2 kills) and paused the run. Its 3 cards are all passives (`바람의 깃털`, `거인의 심장`, `자석 부적`), all marked `새로 얻기`. The starting lantern weapon showed no upgrade card and no new weapon was offered

findings.why: the level-up pace slows quickly after the first two picks
findings.what: step → Run time 0:54, 64 kills, XP bar about 65%. Lv 3 → Lv 4 took 39 seconds of run time, against 14 seconds for Lv 2 → Lv 3 and 4 seconds for Lv 1 → Lv 2

findings.why: the early wave is easy, with no pressure to move
findings.what: key_down W then A+S, step 200ms → Run time 0:34, 40 kills, 13 gold. Many enemies (zombies, bats) were on screen. The player was at full health, not hit once

findings.why: the weapon (the lantern, level 1) kills on its own, but its attack effect is not visible in the capture; I could only see the kill count rise
findings.what: step 200 x40, holding D → at 0:10: 7 kills, 2 gold, level 1 and an empty XP bar, with 3 blue gems lying on the left while the player walked right

findings.why: one run earns less than most single upgrades, so only 자력 is within reach after about 1 min of play
findings.what: tap_anchor result_lobby, lobby_upgrades → Camp gold showed 25 and the shrine showed 25 too. Prices are 50 힘, 40 생명력, 100 서두름, 30 자력, 60 신속, 80 탐욕

findings.why: a big price jump, felt steep for a first upgrade
findings.what: none → the vitality-bought row cost went 40 to 100 for level 2 (more than doubled)

findings.why: the band cuts across the 서두름 and 자력 text for as long as it shows
findings.what: tap_anchor lobby_upgrades, upgrade_buy [upgrade_might] → Shrine panel lists six rows with `금화가 부족해요` over each dimmed button. The press showed a toast, also reading `금화가 부족해요`, as a dark horizontal band across the middle two rows

findings.why: correct behaviour; the toast text is very small and sits on a narrow dark band across the rows, so it is easy to miss
findings.what: tap_anchor result_lobby, lobby_upgrades, upgrade_buy [upgrade_magnet] → gold 27 against cost 30: the press did not buy and a thin toast `금화가 부족해요` showed over the middle of the panel

findings.why: clear feedback; the toast is small as above
findings.what: tap_anchor upgrade_buy [upgrade_vitality] → bought: gold 147 to 107, `Lv 1/5`, one lit pip, next cost 100, toast `생명력 강화 완료!`; the other buy buttons turned bright where affordable

findings.why: Under `presentation`, these are code-made boxes next to art-framed panels.
findings.what: The health/weapon box (top left), the kills/gold box (top right) and the three stat rows of the result panel are plain dark single-color rectangles with a thin outline. The other panels use art frames.
